rapport_notes: Professional and organized, but somewhat mechanical and lacking natural warmth or personalization; limited engagement beyond transactional checklist.
process_discipline_notes: No silence held after 'does that feel fair' — rep immediately re-pitches with Meet Your Mover and communication details without pause for customer processing.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I just need five to five minutes of your time if that's okay? — framing present but vague on the benefit/accurate quote promise.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistical probing (room count, distances, boxes, furniture) without requesting customer's top concerns or priorities.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up probing on any customer concern. All logistics answered in single Q&A, no 'tell me more' or layered discovery.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: A few days before your move you will receive an email introducing the movers to you and then we will call a day before to check-in one last time — this is Meet Your Mover coverage (Stage 2, as takeaway).
evidence_quotes.communication: Covered in Stage 2: email introducing movers, day-before call, email/call availability — satisfies Communication differentiator.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: I'm thinking that this could only finish within four hours to five hours — provides a range but does NOT personalize to specific factors (stairs, distance, second-floor, etc.); it's a generic 4–5 hour window, not anchored to the call details.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we use during the move and the time will only start as soon as our team arrives.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: This is only an estimate. So, if ever the move takes less than this... — establishes the window concept.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair: Not explicitly asked. Rep delivers Save Your Ass language without a pause or check-in gate.
evidence_quotes.close: No rate-lock statement. No explicit ask ('would you like our help' or equivalent). Conversation ends with confirmation of existing booking and goodbyes.

top_strength: Methodical, organized logistics discovery—rep confirmed every detail of the move (square footage, floor count, distances, furniture list, destination) with clarity and accuracy, creating a solid foundation for the estimate.
coaching_note: You skipped the single highest-priority question in the script: ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' *before* diving into logistics—this is how you discover what actually matters to Chris and where to plant your differentiators; right now you're following a checklist instead of having a conversation.
